name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Customer Operations Supervisor | Team Coaching, KPI Management & Escalation Handling
summary: Customer operations leader with 15+ years in customer-facing roles and 2 years supervising a remote team of 20 (later 8) at Wix. Coached and developed specialists against monthly targets, handled escalations, trained new hires, and built the processes and data standards that let a new business line scale to profitability. Comfortable running a team from dashboards and metrics, and staying calm with frustrated customers.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Own client relationships for service businesses, reporting performance on a regular cadence and building automated workflows that keep customer follow-up consistent.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Resolved client feedback and issues promptly across multi-stakeholder accounts to protect satisfaction and retention.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Managed 15-20 reseller partners, including agencies serving healthcare clients, retaining all but one (~94%) by tracking performance data and stepping in early.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Led the sales team alongside an individual book, and built processes that improved reporting accuracy and reduced handoff errors.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Supervised and developed a remote team of customer-facing onboarding specialists for 2 years (20, later 8), overseeing budgets, scope, and delivery.
Coached the team against monthly targets while personally handling 25+ client launches a month, holding 110% of implementation and 120% of sales targets.
Contributed to hiring, onboarding, and training new team members, and built sales training for tenured account executives.
Drove process improvements for a new vertical that went from proof of concept to a profitable business line.
Standardized the CRM fields the team used, improving data capture and accuracy for reporting.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Escalated account risk to leadership early and resolved client issues with direct guidance; ranked top three in sales while quota roughly doubled.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
